newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas sees franked divs this year.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas sees franked divs this year.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd expected to pay a fully franked dividend later this year, managing director James Strong said in an interview broadcast on Sunday.

"At the end of the year (December) when we pay our final dividend on this financial year, we will have paid tax to make franking at the end of this financial year (to June 30, 1997)," Strong told the Nine Network's Business Sunday programme.
Strong said he expected the final dividend would be fully franked.

Under Australia's taxation system, dividends from companies that pay a certain amount of tax are partially or fully tax free and are said to be 'franked'. This is to ensure company profits are not taxed twice.
Qantas said in November the final dividend for 1996/97 was likely to be franked, but could not give a final confirmation.
Qantas set an unchanged and unfranked 6.5 cent per share interim dividend this week after posting a 2.1 percent rise in net profit for the six months to December 31 of A$151.4 million.
Strong said Qantas would aim to continue issuing fully franked dividends after the initial fully franked dividend in December.
